blocks.markdown: DeltaAI interactive comparison October21: the explicitly authorized transfer completed, and the full40,456,772,509-byte π0.5 KR checkpoint passed SHA25609c0466b8809bc8e5f0dc248da135bcb186c64bb0759557def0bfdaee9119e6c. Both clusters produced the same exact210-update warmup/timing anchor sequence (SHA2560f18a66052fd83cbf8d7fb2502b063d13c1852dfcf1be66d5ddbadad3a87defb). The isolated GH200120GB/PyTorch2.12 environment passed pinned π0.5 imports, audited train/validation two-camera decoding, BF16 cache and optimizer-continuation CPU contracts, and the two-rank coordinated-flag test. Interactive diagnostic3429682 is PENDINGPriority for2GH200/32CPU/256GiB, with a2hour allocated GPU cap; its separate controller can wait for resources without a premature queue deadline. The previous short request3429648 timed out before allocation, and pending3429662 was deliberately replaced to repair its queue-controller deadline; both had zero GPU runtime and remain historical. No GPU comparison results exist yet. The unchanged frozen diagnostic manifest is591ae5d7af07b30e93a73ceaaadbd90790781cd598dfbbef139c34f7376d8354. Planned variants are repeated controls, CPU tokenization, transfer prefetch,12workers, autocast weight caching and disabling activation recomputation, restoring identical model/optimizer/scheduler/two-rank RNG/cursor from60,004saved updates, with native global32, loss/all-gradient checks and15%actual memory headroom. Throughput comparisons will be within the same DeltaAI allocation; GH200/PyTorch differences prevent treating absolute cross-cluster rates as a code speedup. Production runs and the paused follow-up monitor remain unchanged. Evidence: maintenance/pi05_deltaai_comparison_20261021/status.json and control_queue_r3/submission.json.
